In regular removal proceedings under section 240 of 
the  Immigration  and  Nationality  Act  (“INA”),  an 
Immigration  Judge

See  8  U.S.C.  §§  1229,  1229a(a)(1).    Those  proceedings

Court.    See  8  U.S.C.  § 1252(a)(1);  28  U.S.C.  §§  2342, 
2350.
